title: PXAPI measurement record v1
description: One normalised measurement or observation from one provider about one subject (Confluence 39846055 §5, §18). Downstream modules work against this form, never against provider raw data. Missing measurement is not a website weakness: a record that was NOT_ASSESSED, or whose value is UNKNOWN, carries an explicit reason and a null value — never a zero, an empty value or a negative finding. The absence of a record carries no meaning at all.

run_id.description: Required. The Analysis Run this record belongs to.

record_id.description: Required. The stable identity of this record; website-evidence items reference it.

metric_id.description: Required. The stable identity of the metric, so that later runs can be compared.

subject.description: Required. What was measured or observed.

collection_pass.description: Required. Which analysis pass produced the record: the baseline pass or the intent-driven targeted pass (Confluence 39846055 §8).

assessment_state.description: Required. Whether the subject was assessed at all.

value_state.description: Conditional. Present if and only if assessment_state is MEASURED or OBSERVED: whether the assessment produced a value. Forbidden for NOT_ASSESSED, where no value state exists.

value.description: Required, nullable. The measured value when value_state is KNOWN; null when value_state is UNKNOWN or assessment_state is NOT_ASSESSED. The value's shape is metric-specific and deliberately open; it is the only open node in the v1 contracts.

unknown_reason.description: Conditional. Present if and only if value_state is UNKNOWN: the stable reason code why the assessment produced no value.

not_assessed_reason.description: Conditional. Present if and only if assessment_state is NOT_ASSESSED: why the subject was not assessed. Every reason describes the analysis process, never the website.

unit.description: Optional. The unit of a numeric value (e.g. ms, bytes, percent). Absent means the value is unitless; an unknown unit is not representable in v1.

source_type.description: Required. The kind of source the record was derived from.

source_ref.description: Required. Where the record comes from.

provider.description: Required. The provider that produced the record; providers are interchangeable behind this contract.

method_version.description: Required. The version of the measurement method, so that records from different runs are comparable only when the method is the same.

measured_at.description: Required. When the measurement or observation was taken, or when the assessment was attempted for a NOT_ASSESSED record.

confidence.description: Required, nullable. The provider's confidence in the record on the 0..5 scale; null if and only if assessment_state is NOT_ASSESSED, because nothing was assessed.

raw_ref.description: Optional. A reference to the retained provider raw payload. Absent means no raw payload was retained.
